name: What types of insulation are available for residential homes?

mainEntity.name: What types of insulation are available for residential homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common residential insulation types include fiberglass batts and rolls, blown-in cellulose or fiberglass, spray foam (open-cell and closed-cell), and rigid foam boards. Fiberglass is cost-effective and widely used. Cellulose, often made from recycled paper, is a dense, eco-friendly option. Spray foam provides excellent air sealing and high R-values, while rigid foam boards are good for specific areas like basements or exterior walls. Each type has distinct properties regarding R-value, installation, and cost.
